recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-screen composition featuring a male subject in a fedora. The left side shows a dark silhouette against a deep red, textured background, while the right side shows a detailed profile in high-contrast lighting against a stark white background. The two halves are separated by a thin vertical red line.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the dark silhouette and the illuminated profile
High contrast between the white negative space and the black fedora
Textural continuity between the distressed type and the grainy background
coreInvariants: Tri-color palette of red, black, and white

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the full height of the frame, centered horizontally at the split point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bridge of the nose on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright profile on the right, moves down to the large bottom-left text, then up to the top-left sticker element.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy white negative space in the bottom right corner balances the dense red and black on the left.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red (background left side and divider line)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast on the right; low value, high saturation on the left.

letterConstructionRules: Distressed, weathered texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Periods between letters in secondary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact distressed display face paired with a clean, condensed secondary face.
graphicDevices: Simulated rectangular sticker in top left

preserve: Distressed texture of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky presence of the display text.
Appropriate for the condensed secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical split image. The left side is a dark silhouette of a man in a fedora against a textured deep red wall. The right side is a brightly lit profile of the same man against a pure white background. A thin red vertical line separates the two halves.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, distressed white sans-serif text in the bottom left corner. Apply a smaller, clean red condensed sans-serif title in the bottom right corner. Add a red rectangular 'sticker' graphic in the top left with small white condensed text.

verificationChecks: Is the text on the left distressed while the text on the right is clean?
Does the fedora maintain a sharp silhouette against the white background?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red background texture
Level of distress on the main typography
Width of the vertical divider line
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between the profile and the white background
Gritty, urban texture on the red side

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red on the left matches the red of the text on the right.
Check that the distressed texture doesn't make the text unreadable.
Verify the subject's profile is crisp and well-defined.
Confirm the 'sticker' element looks like an overlay rather than part of the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen profile + High-contrast lighting + Distressed block typography + Tri-color palette (Red/Black/White)
